topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I was scrolling through my messages, the usual evening ritual, when a name caught my eye. It was Jamie, an online friend with whom I've shared countless conversations and laughs. Out of curiosity, I decided to ask where they lived. When Jamie's reply came through, I was taken aback. "Surprisingly close," they texted, and a rush of something almost electric flowed through me. We were in the same city. The keyboard felt lighter under my fingers as I typed a response, the city suddenly more vibrant, its streets and cafes now holding the promise of new possibilities.
